MP Rojgar Panjiyan Online Form 2025 - Complete Details

Short Information : Madhya Pradesh Employment Exchange Office, under the MP Rojgar Department, invites applicants for online registration (Panjiyan) for new employment opportunities and renewal services. This online registration process connects job seekers with potential employers in both government and private sectors. Those Candidates Are Interested to Registration in MP Rojgar Panjiyan must check the complete details for MP Rojgar Panjiyan Online Form 2025 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 01 January 2017
  • Last Date : 31 December 2025
  • Last Date for Renewal : 31 December 2025
  • Job Fair Start : January / December 2025 Jobs Fair Will Made Time to Time.

Application Fee

  • There is no application fee for MP Rojgar Panjiyan (Registration). All unemployed candidates can register online for free.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
